title: Vocabulary type
description: An entity, relationship or attribute type in the vocabulary registry. See docs/design.md, Knowledge model and schema evolution, and docs/adr/0002-vocabulary-registry.md.

name.description: Entity types use the type form of an entity ID; relationship and attribute types use the predicate form. One namespace for all kinds.

parent.description: Name of the parent type, of the same kind. Absent for a root type.

c4Level.description: C4 level; inherited from the parent type when absent.

shape.description: Default shape; inherited from the parent type when absent.

icon.description: Default icon; inherited from the parent type when absent.

objectKind.description: Attribute types only: the kind of value the objects of its facts must have. Inherited from the parent type when absent; any value is allowed if no type in the line sets it.

keyAttributes.description: Relationship and attribute types only: the attributes of its facts that are part of what a fact claims, on top of those the parent type names; the others are descriptive (docs/adr/0090-key-attributes.md). Each must be declared by the type or an ancestor. Absent means none of its own.

attributeSchema.description: A subset of JSON Schema for the fact's attributes, on top of the parent type's. additionalProperties defaults to true, as in JSON Schema.

items.description: Schema for every element; array attributes only.
